The best value of the lot is the Asus TUF Gaming F16 at ₹34,990. It has the strongest processor and a graphics card for the price.

Laptop	Price	Processor	RAM
Asus TUF Gaming F16 FX677VU	₹34,990	13th Gen Core i7 (6GB graphics)	16 GB
Xiaomi Redmi Book 14 (2025) Refreshed	₹40,990	13th Gen Core i5	16 GB
MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN	₹43,219	Ryzen 5 7530U	16 GB

All three have a 512 GB SSD and Windows 11. The Redmi Book is still marked Upcoming, so it may not be in shops yet. The TUF and MSI are already on sale. Prices come from the Smartprix list updated on Wed 28 Oct, so check the final price at the shop before you buy.
